question: Does consistent neural/SLO onset provenance improve timing-based root ranking?
scope: Synthetic R0 timing/provenance analysis only. No OpenRCA, RCAEval, E003 remediation, or downstream RCA work.

treatments.mixed_current: Current R0 hybrid: SLO onsets are preferred; neural onsets fill services without an SLO onset; timing may compare sources.
treatments.same_source_only: Same detector/candidate set and weights as current R0, but temporal explanation/ranking uses a cause-effect pair only when both onsets have the same provenance source (SLO/SLO or neural/neural).
treatments.timing_disabled: Same detector/candidate set and weights as current R0, with temporal ordering disabled.

controls.candidate_generation: Identical union of SLO breaches and neural flags for all treatments.
controls.neural_threshold: Bundle validation-selected threshold; no retuning per treatment or seed.
controls.evaluation: Same one-to-one incident matching and event-level Top-1 logic for all treatments.

metrics.primary: paired event-level Top-1 difference: same_source_only minus mixed_current
metrics.uncertainty: 2,000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples over all evaluated event IDs, seed 909

predefined_gates.repeatability: PASS only if all three end-to-end repetitions produce an identical canonical metrics SHA-256 and each command exits 0.
predefined_gates.treatment_integrity: PASS only if same_source_only records zero cross-source temporal pairs and mixed_current records the candidate/onset provenance needed for audit.
predefined_gates.superiority: A superiority claim is permitted only if same_source_only minus mixed_current is at least +0.050 Top-1 and the two-sided 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound is greater than 0, while aggregate false alerts are not higher. Otherwise no superiority claim is permitted.
predefined_gates.overall: PASS only if repeatability and treatment_integrity pass. The performance/superiority gate is reported separately; its failure makes the hypothesis unsupported, not a failed reproduction.

selection_rule: All listed repetitions, held-out seeds, treatments, metrics, and bootstrap seed will be reported. No run, event, metric, seed, subset, or configuration may be selected after results are known.
